# Note

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Note`](gmeow-Note.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Note>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notes`](../../slices/notes.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A piece of content in a personal or collective knowledge graph — an annotation body, a Zettelkasten card, a comment, or a standalone thought. Grounded as an information object whose authorship is mediated by [`Participation`](gmeow-Participation.md) / [`wasAttributedTo`](../properties/gmeow-wasAttributedTo.md), whose temporal scope is carried by the four clocks, and whose standpoint is indexed by [`accordingTo`](../properties/gmeow-accordingTo.md). Reuses [`isAbout`](../properties/gmeow-isAbout.md) and [`hasTag`](../properties/gmeow-hasTag.md) / [`Tagging`](gmeow-Tagging.md) for topic and tagging; does not mint parallel properties.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Note`](gmeow-Note.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

### Annotations And Notes

- **Source:** [`slices/extensions/notes/examples/annotations-and-notes.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/extensions/notes/examples/annotations-and-notes.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-extensions-notes-examples-annotations-and-notes)#example-slices-extensions-notes-examples-annotations-and-notes

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example: notes and annotations. A gmeow:Note is a first-class
# information object — authored, timestamped, and linked to other notes by
# gmeow:hasWikilink and to entities by gmeow:mentions (the Zettelkasten / linked-
# note pattern). A gmeow:Highlight is the W3C-Web-Annotation shape for pure
# highlighting: a gmeow:annotationTarget, a precise gmeow:annotationTargetSpan
# (a text-quote Selector), and a gmeow:annotationMotivation — but NO body (a
# highlight just marks a span; for an annotation that says something, a body-
# bearing gmeow:Annotation subclass is used). A gmeow:Comment is a Note that
# threads under a parent.
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/notes/> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

# --- A linked note: authored, mentions an entity, wikilinks to another note.
ex:note1 a gmeow:Note ;
    gmeow:noteAuthor    ex:dana ;
    gmeow:noteContent   "Transformers replaced RNNs for most NLP tasks by 2020." ;
    gmeow:noteCreatedAt "2026-06-10T08:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime ;
    gmeow:hasWikilink   ex:note2 ;
    gmeow:mentions      ex:paper .
```
